dedupe_keys.name: idb container port technical efficiency scores for 63 latin american and caribbean ports 1999 2009 stochastic frontier estimates

description: The IDB published the replication data for its study benchmarking container port technical efficiency in Latin America and the Caribbean. Contents: annual technical efficiency scores (per cent) from a stochastic production frontier model for 63 container ports, one row per port with its country, a score for each year from 1999 to 2009 and the period average; for example San Juan, Puerto Rico averages 80.6. Producer: IDB Infrastructure and Energy Sector, supporting its Container Port Performance work. Coverage: 63 container ports across the region, 1999 to 2009. Format and access: a 5 KB CSV on IDB Open Data with a DOI and CKAN datastore API; no registration. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO. Caveats: the file holds only the efficiency scores, not the throughput, berth, crane and area inputs used to estimate them, and the series stops in 2009. Simulation uses: setting relative port productivity or capacity factors in regional maritime freight network models and comparing port performance over time. Related records: the IDB freight transport and logistics statistics yearbook (data-idb-freight-transport-logistics-statistics-yearbook-2012-2014) gives port infrastructure and traffic indicators for later years.
